ud1.7:1.2: on one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Pāva at the Ajakalāpaka [Herd-of-Goats] shrine, the dwelling of the Ajakalāpaka spirit.
ud1.7:1.3: And on that occasion, in the pitch-black darkness of the night, the Blessed One was sitting in the open air, and the rain was falling in scattered drops.
ud1.7:1.4: Then the Ajakalāpaka spirit–wanting to cause fear, terror, & horripilation in the Blessed One–went to him and, on arrival, not far from him, three times made a commotion & pandemonium: “Commotion & pandemonium! Commotion & pandemonium! Commotion & pandemonium!–
ud1.7:1.5: That’s a goblin for you, contemplative!”
ud1.7:2.1: Then, on realizing the significance of that, the Blessed One on that occasion exclaimed:
ud1.7:3.1:
When,
with regard to his own qualities,
a brahman is one
